content: Nawe awe Tito, obhe oreegya abhaatu kuriingʼaana na ameegyo go obhuheene.
Obhabhuurire abhakaruka bhabhe na kusuuhu, bho obhusuuku na bhano bhakwiibhaaha. Kweeki, bhabhe no obhwiikirirya bhwe eheene, bhabhe no obhuseegi no obhwiikongʼeererya.
Egoego na abhakiikuru nabho, obhabhuurire kubha bhabhe ne eteemwa yino ekumuguungya Taatabhugya. Bhatabha abhamoonyi, bhatabha abhanywi abharaara, nawe bhareenderwa okweegya ameegyo ge esiira enzomu,
okubha bhabhe bharabheegya abhaakya kubhaseega abhasubhe bhaabhu na abhaana bhaabhu.

Kweeki, bhabhe bharabheegya kubha na kusuuhu, bhabhe ne ekoro nzomu, bhakore bhuzomu emirimo muziinyuumba zyaabhu, bhabhe bhazomu na bhano bhakusuuka abhasubhe bhaabhu. Obhabhuurire bhakore ego, okubha engʼana ya Taatabhugya etazeerwa.
Egoego na abhamura, obharekye bhabhe na kusuuhu.
Naawe, mumangʼana goosi, obhe ekireengyo kyo okweegwa kweebho kwo okukora amazomu. Obhe omuheene no omugumiru mumeegyo gaazo.
Ameegyo gaazo gabhe ge eheene na gatabha na amasoro kubhaatu. Naabhe omuutu areenda kugahakana, arasuukibhwa, kwo okubha atakubha ne engʼana yo okutugaamba bhubhi.
Kweeki abhagya nabho, obhabhuurire kubha bhabhasuuke abhakuru bhaabhu mugoosi, bhabhasaambaarukye, na bhatahakana nabho.
Bhatabha bhiibhi, nawe bhabhe abhaheene, okubha emirimo gyaabhu gyoosi, gikore abhaatu bharutwe na ameegyo ga Taatabhugya Omutuurya weetu.
Obhe oreegya amangʼana gayo, kwo okubha Taatabhugya abheerekirye orubhaango rwaaye, kwo okureeta obhutuurya kubhaatu bhoosi.

Orubhaango ruyo, ruratweegya okwaanga obhubhi ne enaamba ye ekyaaro. Kweego, hano tukyaari mukyaaro kino, tubhe na kusuuhu, bhe eheene, na abhaatu bhano bhakwiikara obhwiikari bhwo okumuseengera Taatabhugya.
Twiikare ego, eriibhaga rino tukwiisigira orusiku rwo orubhaango, hano Yeesu Krisito araakyoore arorekane mubhuguungo bhwaaye. Ewe niwe Taatabhugya weetu Omukuru no Omutuurya weetu.
Akiiruusya kwiiguru weetu, okubha atutuurye okurwa mubhibhi bhyoosi. Akeenda okutweerya, okubha tubhe abhaatu bhaaye bhe eheene, bhano bhakwiiruusya okukora amazomu.
Ambe bhoono, obhe oreegya amangʼana gayo goosi. Oheerwe obhuturo bhwoosi bhwo okugumirya no okurekya abhaatu. Kweego, otazeerwa na muutu wowoosi.
